insurer: ICICI Lombard General Insurance Company Limited
sumInsured: Annual Sum Insured as per Policy Schedule (not provided in extract)

great.name: Restore Benefit
great.quote: We will reset up to 100% of the Annual Sum Insured, Once for same illness/disease/injury and Unlimited times for different illness/disease/injury for the same Insured Person in a Policy Year
great.explanation: The sum insured is restored once for the same illness and unlimited times for different illnesses within a policy year. This provides strong protection if you exhaust coverage on multiple conditions.

great.name: Built-in SI Buffer
great.quote: We will provide a Loyalty Bonus of 20% of expiring or renewed Annual Sum Insured (whichever is lower) at the end of each Policy Year... If the Insured Persons in the expiring Policy are covered on an individual basis... In the event of Claim... the credited Loyalty Bonus will not be reduced.
great.explanation: Your sum insured increases by 20% each year as a loyalty bonus, which is not reduced after claims. This acts as extra coverage without extra premium.

great.name: Modern Treatments
great.quote: We will cover the Medical Expenses... for the below mentioned Technological advancements and Treatments... Robotic surgeries, Stem cell therapy: Hematopoietic stem cells for bone marrow transplant..., Deep Brain stimulation... Bronchical Thermoplasty, IONM
great.explanation: Advanced procedures like robotic surgery and stem cell therapy are covered. This ensures access to modern treatments often excluded in weaker plans.

great.name: Cashless Network
great.quote: We will respond within 1 hours of the actual receipt of such pre authorization request... grant final authorization within three hours of the receipt of discharge authorization request from the hospital.
great.explanation: The insurer commits to quick cashless claim approvals within hours. This means faster hospital admissions and discharge settlements.

good.name: PED Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing Disease (PED)... shall be excluded until the expiry of 12/24 months (as per the plan opted) of continuous coverage
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are excluded for either 12 or 24 months depending on your plan. Both durations are acceptable market standards.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage
good.explanation: Treatment for specified diseases is excluded for 24 months from policy start. This is a standard waiting period in health insurance.

good.name: Initial Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident
good.explanation: Illnesses are excluded for the first 30 days except accidents. This is a common initial waiting period.

good.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: We will cover the Post-hospitalization Medical Expenses... up to the limits as specified in the Policy Schedule
good.explanation: Medical expenses after hospitalization are covered as per limits in your policy schedule. This helps with recovery costs after discharge.

good.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: We will cover the Pre-hospitalization Medical Expenses... up to the limits as specified in the Policy Schedule
good.explanation: Medical expenses before hospitalization are covered within limits stated in your policy schedule. This supports diagnosis and treatment before admission.

good.name: Domiciliary Hospitalization
good.quote: We will cover the Medical Expenses incurred in respect of the Domiciliary Hospitalization... provided that: i. The Domiciliary Hospitalization continues for at least 3 consecutive days
good.explanation: Home-based hospitalization is covered if it lasts at least 3 days. This provides coverage for treatment at home when hospital admission is not possible.

good.name: Air Ambulance
good.quote: We will cover the expenses incurred on Air Ambulance services up to the Annual Sum Insured... It is for a life threatening emergency health conditions... Domestic Road Ambulance services cannot be provided.
good.explanation: Air ambulance is covered for life-threatening emergencies up to the sum insured. This ensures quick emergency transport when needed.

good.name: Optional Covers
good.quote: Optional Covers available under the Policy: ... Maternity Cover & New Born Baby Cover ... Super Loyalty Bonus ... Sum Insured Protector ... Claim Protector ... Worldwide Cover
good.reference: Policy Schedule section a.IX (Page 4) and Section d.B (Pages 27-37)
good.explanation: You can add optional covers like maternity and worldwide cover by paying extra premium. These add flexibility and extra benefits.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote: medicines, drugs and consumables (other than those specified in the list of excluded expenses (non-medical) in Annexure I)
bad.reference: Section d.A.1(v) (Page 13) and Non Payables List (Pages 47-51)
bad.explanation: Many common hospital consumables and non-medical items are excluded unless you opt for the Claim Protector add-on. This may cause out-of-pocket expenses.

bad.name: Room Rent
bad.quote: We will cover... i. Room Rent charges
bad.explanation: The policy wording does not specify any room rent category or limit, so your entitlement is unclear without the policy schedule. This can lead to unexpected capping.

bad.name: No Classic NCB
bad.quote: Loyalty Bonus means any increase or addition in the Sum Insured granted by the insurer without an associated increase in premium.
bad.explanation: The policy offers a loyalty bonus but does not describe a traditional No Claim Bonus that reduces premium or resets on claim. This may be less beneficial if you expect classic NCB.

bad.name: Claim Intimation
bad.quote: The above information needs to be provided... within 10 days of Hospitalisation, failing which We will have the right to treat the Claim as inadmissible, as We may deem fit at Our sole discretion.
bad.explanation: If you fail to inform the insurer within 10 days of hospitalization, your claim can be rejected at the insurer's discretion. This is a strict requirement.

bad.name: Home Care Approval
bad.quote: Prior approval from Us has been taken... In case the Insured Person breaches the conditions of approval or fails to take the prior written approval from Company, we are not liable to settle any claim under this section.
bad.explanation: Home care treatment requires prior written approval; without it, claims under this section will be denied. This limits flexibility for home treatment.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: Co-Payment means a cost sharing requirement... the policyholder/insured will bear a specified percentage of the admissible claims amount.
bad.reference: Definitions (Page 7) and Exclusions intro (Page 37): "...or Co-payment amount, if applicable and as specifically defined in the Policy Schedule"
bad.explanation: The policy defines co-pay but does not specify the percentage in the base plan wording. You need to check your policy schedule to know if co-pay applies.

unclear.name: Pre/Post-hospitalization
unclear.quote: up to the limits as specified in the Policy Schedule
unclear.explanation: Pre- and post-hospitalization coverage exists but the exact number of days or amount is not stated here. Refer to your policy schedule for details.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
